importantNotes: Matthew uses 'fulfilled' about 12 times — showing Jesus as the fulfillment of the OT.
The Sermon on the Mount (chs. 5-7) is the greatest ethical teaching ever given.
Matthew is the most Jewish of the Gospels — written to convince Jews that Jesus is the Messiah.
The kingdom parables (ch. 13) explain the unexpected nature of God's kingdom.
The Great Commission (28:19-20) is the church's marching orders.

chapters.1: The genealogy of Jesus from Abraham through David; the birth of Jesus to the Virgin Mary.
chapters.2: The Magi visit; Herod kills Bethlehem's infants; the family flees to Egypt.
chapters.3: John the Baptist prepares the way; Jesus is baptized in the Jordan.
chapters.4: Jesus is tempted by Satan in the wilderness; He begins His ministry in Galilee.
chapters.5: The Sermon on the Mount begins — the Beatitudes, salt and light, the higher righteousness.
chapters.6: The Lord's Prayer; teaching on giving, prayer, fasting, worry, and treasures in heaven.
chapters.7: Do not judge; the narrow gate; build on the rock; the crowds are amazed.
chapters.8: Jesus heals a leper, a centurion's servant, Peter's mother-in-law; calms the storm.
chapters.9: Jesus forgives and heals a paralytic; calls Matthew; raises a dead girl.
chapters.10: Jesus sends out the twelve apostles with authority; instructions for mission.
chapters.11: John the Baptist's question; Jesus denounces unrepentant cities; 'Come to me, all who are weary.'
chapters.12: Sabbath controversies; healing the man with a withered hand; blasphemy against the Holy Spirit.
chapters.13: Parables of the kingdom — the sower, the weeds, the mustard seed, the treasure, the pearl.
chapters.14: John the Baptist beheaded; feeding of the 5,000; Jesus walks on water.
chapters.15: Clean and unclean; the Canaanite woman's faith; feeding of the 4,000.
chapters.16: Peter's confession: 'You are the Christ'; Jesus predicts His death.
chapters.17: The Transfiguration; healing a demon-possessed boy; the Temple tax.
chapters.18: Who is the greatest? The lost sheep; forgiveness — seventy times seven; the unmerciful servant.
chapters.19: Teaching on divorce, children, and the rich young man; 'the last will be first.'
chapters.20: The parable of workers in the vineyard; Jesus predicts His death; serving, not ruling.
chapters.21: The triumphal entry; cleansing the Temple; the fig tree; authority questioned.
chapters.22: The parable of the wedding feast; taxes to Caesar; the greatest commandment.
chapters.23: Seven woes against the Pharisees — hypocrisy exposed; lament over Jerusalem.
chapters.24: The Olivet Discourse — signs of the end, tribulation, and the coming of the Son of Man.
chapters.25: Parables of the ten virgins, the talents, and the sheep and goats (final judgment).
chapters.26: The plot against Jesus; the Last Supper; Gethsemane; betrayal; trial before Caiaphas.
chapters.27: Jesus before Pilate; the crucifixion; death and burial of Jesus.
chapters.28: The resurrection; the women at the empty tomb; the Great Commission.
